title: Exposía: Academic Writing Assessment of Exposés and Peer Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-assigned rubric scores to two distinct groups of human raters (one explicitly instructed to grade leniently in favor of the student, and one without such instructions) and measuring the agreement (Quadratic Weighted Agreement) to demonstrate that LLMs systematically align better with the more generous human graders.

Calculating the simple mean difference (Δμ) and chance-corrected agreement metrics between different groups of human raters (in-semester vs. post-semester instructors) to identify systemic severity or leniency differences across rating groups.
